h3. *Title*

Broker Home Screen – Data-Driven Dashboard Implementation

----

h3. *Problem Statement*

Brokers need a centralized home screen immediately after login to view high-level account activity and access primary workflows without navigating multiple pages.
For this story you MUST follow the design exactly - spacing, typography colors, layout.

You MUST use only components that appear in the COMPONENT_FILES.
You MUST NOT create new components unless explicitly listed.

You Must NOT modify existing components, or their APIs.

----

h3. *User Story*

As a *Broker*,
I want to see a summary of my active business and next actions on login,
So that I can quickly understand my workload and navigate to key areas.

----

h3. *Design Source*

* Figma: _(link)_

----

h2. *Rules* 

# Output files 

You must output exactly the following file:
/app/home/page.tsx

This is where the Broker home screen will be defined.

h2. *2.page.tsx*

This file MUST:
Assemble the entire screen.

Use only components defined above.

Match layout of the PNG and Figma structure.

Make sure the components are in the correct order on the screen. DO NOT mix up the placement of the components.

follow spacing tokens.

The “View all client” section, when responsive should be 1 SINGLE ROW that you can scroll horizontally through.

The “Latest News” section, when responsive should be 1 SINGLE ROW that you can scroll horizontally through.

The “Commissions” section, when responsive should be 1 SINGLE ROW that you can scroll horizontally through.

Components MUST use entire width of screen that is available to them, through every screen size.

Headers for each component MUST match styles from figma design. Meaning, NO deviation from font weight, or color.

h2. *3.Absolutely NO deviations.*

the model may NOT:
Add new buttons.

add blue confirm or cancel buttons.

change layout.

change color.

change spacing.

replace the bottom nav with something else.

replace any styles.

replace cards with generic cards.
